## European Cups

### Niners Chemnitz fall to Napoli in EuroCup with 90:112 loss

Niners Chemnitz suffered their second consecutive loss in the EuroCup, falling to Napoli 90:112 in their own hall. Despite a strong comeback in the third quarter, Chemnitz ultimately fell short, with Napoli pulling away in the final period. Cobe Williams led the Niners with 21 points, but it was not enough to overcome the visitors, who were led by their strong start and defense. Napoli dominated the second quarter, outscoring Chemnitz 42:24, and held a 18-point lead at halftime. Chemnitz's coach Rodrigo Pastore's halftime speech seemed to inspire his team, as they fought back in the third quarter, narrowing the deficit to 5 points. However, the energy spent on the comeback ultimately proved costly, and Napoli pulled away in the final period, securing the win.

### Bamberg Baskets Suffer 66-98 Loss to UCAM Murcia in Spain

The Bamberg Baskets remain winless in the Basketball Champions League after a 66-98 loss to UCAM Murcia in Spain. The team, led by Head Coach Jesús Ramírez, struggled to keep up with the hosts, who took control of the game in the second quarter. Despite a brief surge by the Baskets, UCAM Murcia's lead grew throughout the game, with the hosts dominating the boards 43-28. Souley Boum Jr. led the Baskets with 21 points, while Daniel Keppeler added 11 and Trevon Scott and Hason Ward each scored 10. The loss leaves the Baskets with no wins after four games in the group stage.

## Around the League

### Telekom Baskets Bonn Join Bonn's Rosenmontagszug 2027

The Telekom Baskets Bonn will participate in Bonn's Rosenmontagszug 2027 on February 8, 2027. Fans can join the team in the procession, which will include throwing candies and celebrating Carnival. Registration for the event is now open on the Baskets website, with special conditions for fans, including lower prices for participation and a free team costume. The team is also looking for volunteers to help with the event, known as Wagenengel, who can contact the team via email to express their interest.

Sources:

- [Telekom Baskets Bonn: Baskets Alaaf: Zusammen zum Rosenmontagszug 2027](https://www.telekom-baskets-bonn.de/presse/newsarchiv/baskets-alaaf-zusammen-zum-rosenmontagszug-2027)

### Gladiators Trier Win Big in Europe Cup vs BC Batumi

The Gladiators Trier have won their sixth game in the Europe Cup, defeating BC Batumi 122:57. This victory marks the sixth win in the sixth game of the group phase for the Gladiators Trier. The team's performance was impressive, with all players contributing to the score. This win follows their recent success in the Basketball Bundesliga, where they have been undefeated in their last five games. The Gladiators Trier are now on a roll, having won six consecutive games in both the Europe Cup and the Basketball Bundesliga.

### Gladiators Trier crush BC Batumi 122:57 in record-breaking away win

The VET-CONCEPT Gladiators Trier secured a record-breaking 122:57 victory over BC Batumi in Georgia. Maik Zirbes and Marco Hollersbacher led the scoring for Trier with 15 points each. The team's starting five, which included Eli Brooks, Behnam Yakhchali, Austin Crowley, Marco Hollersbacher, and EJ Onu, set the tone for the game with EJ Onu scoring the first points with a dunk. The Gladiators dominated the game, with a 20:4 lead after six minutes and a 31:15 lead at the end of the first quarter. They continued to control the game in the second quarter, with a 42:15 lead after 12 minutes. The team will next face the Frankfurt Skyliners on Sunday in the easyCredit BBL.
